subject: [PATCH v2 10/17] selftests/mm: parameterize the mixed-source collapse case by source order

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch modifies the selftests/mm/khugepaged.c test to parameterize the mixed-source collapse case by source order. The test faults a region as order-2 folios and collapses them to the target, but allows for other supported mTHP orders below the target when specified with the -s option. This change is intended to make the test more flexible and adaptable to different system configurations.
